about_the_game:
Kult Rising is a atmospheric found footage Backrooms exploration game centered around realistic graphics, and open ended level design to immerse you in our liminal world. Set in the Sxlaris dimension of the SCP Universe, the Backrooms have been contained inside of SCP-x216, and you along with it!

Explore the seemingly infinite complex as you adventure through liminal, surreal, and dreamcore levels.

Atmosphere over Entities:

The focus of this game is to explore the eerie beauty of liminal and surreal spaces, entities are rare in the backrooms, outside of a handful of levels.

Currently Implemented Features:

Backrooms Cluster 1:

  • Explore the first section of the infamous Backrooms Level 0: The Lobby

Sandbox:

  • test out our hoard shooter mode and play around with upcoming mechanics

  • this is a demo level that acts as our "creative mode"

  • use it to test out new ideas, weapons, and builds!

As we implement more features, Kult Rising will be gradually increasing in price. The next increase is estimated to be: Spring 2025 

Note: Kult Rising follows the Sxlaris canon of both the SCP Foundation, and The Backrooms, more info can be found on our Wiki.

Second Note: To avoid confusion with existing SCPs, any SCPs unique to the Sxlaris universe have an "x" designation in their name (i.e SCP-x173 instead of SCP-173).

Upcoming Features:

Backrooms Levels:

  • Level 0 (expanded)

  • Level 37 (The Poolrooms)

  • Level 188 (The Windows)

  • Level Fun! (The Playrooms)

  • Level 4 (Abandoned Office)

  • And More!

First/Third Person Shooter Combat:

  • survive against waves of zombies

  • collect new weapons, and discover new abilities

Explore the Labyrinth:

  • lethal-like scrap retrieval with a biopunk twist

  • harvest organs and gather evidence to sell and meet your quota

  • survive against the hoards of zombified D-Class personnel, infected by SCP-3127 and SCP-7475-J

  • find lesser cores to travel farther down the labyrinth, until you find a greater core to extract

  • survive the extraction event to earn your rewards

Explore the Backrooms:

  • the Labyrinth is itself the containment site for SCP-x002, The Backrooms

  • explore the yellowrooms and poolrooms, as you retrieve scrap

content_descriptors.notes: You can customize your characters outfits, and if you take their clothes off they will be nude.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
